name: Resolve ExecutionGate legacy-only branch enforcement
goal: Prove that execution branch enforcement accepts every canonical branch form the CLI generates: the EXECUTION_BRANCH_CHECK phase computes candidates without mission/expedition names and demands only the legacy raw-ID form (expedition/<missionId>/<expeditionId>), while ensureExpeditionBranch and assertExecutionBranch accept the preferred slug form — so starting any expedition on its slug-form branch is rejected by the gate that the CLI itself satisfied. Enrich the gate check with names from canonical state so both layers resolve identical candidate sets; cover with tests/execution-branch-gate.test.js
